en.title: Rhapsody of Raindrops and the Golden Eternal Night
en.premise: Asteria, the "city that never sleeps," is a place adorned with glittering dresses and dazzling jewels. Yet, beneath the surface of its endless festivities, a blood-stained conspiracy for the throne unfolds in silence. A fallen noblewoman, a mysterious collector, and knights lurking in the shadows of the royal palace—their fates are thrown into chaos by a "certain memory" obtained from a phantom shop that opens only on rainy days. The storm-tossed masquerade ball will strip away every mask.

zh.title: 雨滴狂想曲与黄金永劫夜
zh.premise: 华服与珠宝交相辉映，那是忘却了黑夜的“不夜城”阿斯忒里亚。在永无止境的庆典背后，一场围绕王座的血腥阴谋正悄然上演。没落的公爵千金、神秘的收藏家，以及在王宫阴影中暗中活动的骑士们。唯有在雨天才会开启的幻之店铺，其间获得的“某段记忆”正令他们的命运走向疯狂。暴风雨中的假面舞会，终将剥落所有的伪装。
